headline: MeshKV reports lower on-chip traffic and higher multi-stream throughput on an FPGA decoder
summary: A paper accepted to IEEE ICCD 2026 presents MeshKV, a network-on-chip fabric for moving transformer KV-cache blocks across tiled accelerators. On an 8×8 Alveo U280 FPGA implementation with LLaMA-2-7B and Mistral-7B at 8K–32K context, the authors report up to 58% lower interconnect traffic, 2.1× KV bandwidth utilization versus a shared baseline, and 1.9× throughput for eight concurrent streams versus a centralized baseline at 32K. The paper reports five-run hardware measurements and ablations; its 17% lower energy per token is an activity-based estimate, not direct whole-system power measurement. Independent reproduction and transfer to commercial accelerators remain open.
